basics.name: Jihwan Kim
basics.label: Undergraduate (Double Major in Mathematics & Computer Science)
basics.summary: Undergraduate at Seoul National University with research interests in efficient optimizers for large language model training, optimizer theory (scaling laws, optimization dynamics), and privacy in machine learning and large language models.

work.name: Optimization & Machine Learning Laboratory
work.summary: Research on the theory of neural scaling laws, with a focus on scaling-law analysis of one-pass signSGD in the power-law random features (PLRF) model.
highlights: Topic: Theory of Neural Scaling Law
Developed scaling-law theory for one-pass signSGD in the PLRF model, deriving a four-term risk decomposition and compute-optimal exponents.

work.name: Cryptography Laboratory
work.summary: Research on homomorphic encryption, focusing on improving the efficiency of CKKS bootstrapping; implemented proposed algorithm in C++.
highlights: Proposed an algorithm to enhance the efficiency of CKKS bootstrapping.
Implemented the proposed algorithm with C++ (code: https://github.com/aqua4689jh/OverModRaise).
Double major in Mathematics and Computer Science.

publications.name: Scaling Laws of SignSGD in Linear Regression: When Does It Outperform SGD?
publications.summary: Scaling-law analysis of one-pass signSGD in the power-law random features (PLRF) model, deriving a four-term risk decomposition and compute-optimal exponents.

publications.name: OverModRaise: Reducing Modulus Consumption of CKKS Bootstrapping
publications.summary: Proposed an algorithm that improves CKKS bootstrapping efficiency by reducing modulus consumption; implemented in C++.
